text:
Emily: Quick sync — can we lock a 30m slot next week for the inference bench readout? Want to cover latency + cost dashboards, the quantization experiments, and the new KV-cache heatmap.
Rahul: I'm +1. prefer Tue/Wed morning. need to reserve the perf cluster (4xA100) for a dry run beforehand.
Nate: Wed works for me. can present the batching/throughput slides.
Sophie: Tue afternoon is rough for me, but i can make Wed 10:30-11:00 PT. also: can we add a 5–10m demo of the new fallback routing behavior?
Lisa: Wed 10:30 PT ok for me. I'll own the cost breakdown section and show the delta after quantization.
Emily: cool — proposed agenda draft:
```
1) 5m: quick goals + acceptance criteria for readout
2) 10m: latency dashboards & anomaly triage (Nate)
3) 8m: quantization results + quality checks (Lisa)
4) 5m: KV-cache heatmap and prefix cache opportunities (Rahul)
5) 5m: fallback routing demo + next steps (Sophie)
``` 
Emily: total 33m — can trim to 30m by collapsing Qs to async issues. @deploy-bot can you create a calendar invite for Wed 10:30 PT and attach the perf cluster reservation? :calendar:
deploy-bot: calendar event created: Wed 10:30 PT — "Inference Bench: Latency/Cost Readout". Perf cluster hold requested (4xA100) for Tue 9:00 PT dry-run and Wed 09:00 PT run. Attendees: Emily, Rahul, Nate, Sophie, Lisa.
Rahul: thanks — i added the perf-run checklist to the invite notes: workload configs, seed prompts, metric tags, and the long-tail latency trace export path.
Nate: small ask — can folks upload any sample output that failed our quality gates to the thread before Tuesday? i'll include in the runbook.
Sophie: will do. also tagging the alerting playbook in case the readout surfaces a regression: https://internal/redwood/playbooks/alerting
Emily: one more thing — who can take notes and issue the follow-up action items? i can if nobody else volunteers.
Lisa: i'll take notes and capture action items. will post the summary + perf spreadsheet link after the run.
Rahul: re: acceptance criteria — adding a short checklist to the invite: max p95 latency target, token/unit cost delta threshold, and no >1% quality regression on eval set.
Emily: perfect. if anyone has additional agenda items reply here by EOD. otherwise we'll lock it and look to the dry-run on Tue.
Sophie: +1. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Lisa: +1 :thumbsup:
Nate: good plan, see you Wed.
